entries.title: The Care setting is now called Rigor
entries.body: The setting that decides how thoroughly a project's work is checked before you merge it is now called Rigor, on Settings, a task's Info, merge cards and the phone app. Its levels stay Quick, Default and Careful, and every project keeps its choice.

picture.alt: A project's Rigor row in Settings, with Careful chosen among Quick, Default and Careful
